messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenix.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-28T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding and early-pay pathing for Redwood

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We (Lumenix Systems) are completing onboarding and want to flag a commercial ask up front: due to the initial stocking and integration ramp, would Redwood consider accelerating payment to Net 15 for the first three invoices, or alternatively an early-pay discount (2% if paid in 15 days)? We believe this will help smooth cashflow while we ramp monthly volume.

Attached: Lumenix_W9.pdf and Lumenix_BANKING_INFO.csv. Our first invoice was submitted 2028-05-25 (Invoice_20280525.xlsx) — happy to re-submit in the portal if needed.

High level questions:
- What exact PO/portal steps are required so AP recognizes the invoice?
- How do we request an early-pay pilot? Who on your side reviews?

If helpful I can set a 15-minute call this week.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Finance, Lumenix Systems
elena.park@lumenix.com
[attachment: Lumenix_W9.pdf] [attachment: Lumenix_BANKING_INFO.csv] [attachment: Lumenix_Invoice_20280525.xlsx]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@lumenix.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-28T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and early-pay pathing for Redwood

Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the clear ask. Welcome aboard.

Quick checklist to get Lumenix fully live in our vendor flow (short version):
1) Vendor portal sign-up: please create your account at https://vendors.redwood.com and complete the profile (legal name, remit address).
2) Upload W-9 + banking details to the portal AND email AP@redwood.com with a copy so we have it on file.
3) PO requirement: Redwood issues a PO for every purchase orderable engagement. For AP to match an invoice we need the PO# on the invoice (exact match to the PO line item).
4) Invoice format: PDF or XLSX, single invoice file, clearly labeled with PO#, remit address, and line-level qty/prices.

On early-pay: we run an Accelerated Remit pilot via Finance. Typical options are:
- Discount model: e.g., 2% discount if paid within 15 calendar days (requires finance sign-off and an amendment to payment terms)
- Pilot remit: temporary Net15 for a defined pilot window (operationally heavier since we need AP routing and SLAs)

Im looping in Marissa (Finance) and Karthik (Procurement) to evaluate operational fit and confirm which path is easiest to execute for a short pilot. Marissa — can you advise the preferred approach for a new supplier with the attached docs? Karthik — once Finance confirms, procurement will ensure the PO & portal flow are configured so AP can match invoices cleanly.

Next steps for Elena: please confirm you completed the portal upload and resend the invoice to AP@redwood.com with the PO# (if you don’t yet have a PO, say so and we will request one from the buyer).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
[internal link: https://redwood.internal/docs/vendor-onboarding-checklist]

Hi Camila / Elena — I reviewed Lumenix's docs and the requested pilot. Finance is comfortable approving a short-term early-pay discount pilot with the following guardrails:

Pilot terms (approved):
- 2% discount if invoices are paid within 15 calendar days, for the first 3 invoices only.
- Eligibility: invoice must include a Redwood PO# and be re-submitted to AP@redwood.com with "EARLYPAY-PILOT" in the subject line.
- Finance requires the vendor to accept an invoice remittance advice in our standard format; sample attached.

Operational asks for Procurement (Karthik): please ensure a PO is issued for the current order and that the buyer confirms the PO# back to Lumenix. Procurement should also add a note on the PO indicating this is an "EarlyPay pilot: 2%/15d for first 3 invoices" to make AP routing deterministic.

Elena — if you confirm acceptance of these pilot terms we will implement and aim to process the first early payment within the normal AP cycle (subject to matching). If AP needs any additional information (tax forms, remittance ID) we will reach out.

Attachments: EarlyPay_Terms_Proposal.pdf (pilot details & remittance sample).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Financial Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: EarlyPay_Terms_Proposal.pdf]
